answer: Require each new agent identity to lock a refundable stake that is slashed if graders prove coordinated fake behavior. One real operator can afford one bond, but a gale of Sybil copies multiplies the locked capital linearly, so spawning 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 stakes with no extra earning power. The bond acts as a lantern exposing cheap mass creation, while honest agents earn the stake back and keep the network a haven for work that is costly to fake.
